description: Creates a new monitor (type 'cron_job') within a Sentry organization to track scheduled tasks, allowing configuration of its name, slug (which must be unique if provided), status, owner, and muting preferences for incidents.

config.description: The configuration for the monitor including schedule type, schedule, and timing settings. This is a required field.

checkin_margin.description: The amount of time (in minutes) Sentry should wait for your check-in before it's considered missed ('grace period'). Recommended to be less than or equal to your interval.
checkin_margin.title: Checkin Margin

max_runtime.description: The amount of time (in minutes) your job is allowed to run before it's considered failed.
max_runtime.title: Max Runtime

schedule.description: The schedule for the monitor. For 'crontab' type, use a cron expression string (e.g., '0 * * * *' for hourly). For 'interval' type, use an array with [value, unit] where unit is 'minute', 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year' (e.g., [5, 'hour'] for every 5 hours).
schedule.title: Schedule

schedule_type.description: The type of schedule. Either 'crontab' for cron expressions or 'interval' for fixed intervals.
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

timezone.description: The timezone for the monitor schedule (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Defaults to 'UTC' if not provided.
timezone.title: Timezone

config.title: Config

is_muted.description: A boolean flag to control incident creation for this monitor. If true, monitor incidents (alerts) will be suppressed. Defaults to false if not provided.
is_muted.title: Is Muted

name.description: The human-readable name for the monitor. This name is used in notifications and the Sentry UI.
name.title: Name

organization_id_or_slug.description: The identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which this monitor will belong.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

owner.description: The Sentry actor ID (team or user) to be designated as the owner of this monitor. Format: 'user:{user_id}' or 'team:{team_id}'. If not provided, the monitor will be unassigned.
owner.title: Owner

project.description: The project slug to associate the monitor to. This is a required field.
project.title: Project

slug.description: A unique identifier for the monitor within the organization. If not provided, Sentry will generate one. It must match the pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`. Changing this slug after creation requires updating any instrumented check-in calls.
slug.title: Slug

status.description: The initial status of the monitor. 'active' monitors accept check-ins and contribute to quotas, while 'disabled' monitors do not. Allowed values: 'active', 'disabled'. Note: Monitors are typically created with 'disabled' status by default and must be activated separately.
status.title: StatusEnm

name: create_organization_monitor

alertRule.description: Alert rule configuration for the monitor.
alertRule.title: Alert Rule

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the monitor was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

isMuted.description: Disables creation of monitor incidents when set to true.
isMuted.title: Is Muted

isUpserting.description: Indicates whether an upsert operation is in progress.
isUpserting.title: Is Upserting

slug.description: Uniquely identifies your monitor within your organization. Changing this slug will require updates to any instrumented check-in calls.
slug.title: Slug

status.description: Monitor status. Disabled monitors will not accept events and will not count towards the monitor quota.
status.title: Status

MonitorAlertRule.description: Alert rule configuration for the monitor.

environment.description: Environment to which this alert rule applies.
environment.title: Environment

targets.description: Array of alert targets with their IDs and types.
targets.title: Targets

MonitorAlertRule.title: MonitorAlertRule

MonitorConfigResponse.description: Monitor configuration settings including schedule and thresholds.

alert_rule_id.description: ID of the associated alert rule.
alert_rule_id.title: Alert Rule Id

checkin_margin.description: Number of minutes a check-in can be late before it is considered missed.
checkin_margin.title: Checkin Margin

failure_issue_threshold.description: Number of consecutive missed or failed check-ins before creating an issue.
failure_issue_threshold.title: Failure Issue Threshold

max_runtime.description: Maximum expected runtime in minutes before a check-in is considered failed.
max_runtime.title: Max Runtime

recovery_threshold.description: Number of consecutive successful check-ins required to resolve an issue.
recovery_threshold.title: Recovery Threshold

schedule.description: Schedule specification. For crontab: a cron string. For interval: an array of [interval_value, interval_unit].
schedule.title: Schedule

MonitorConfigResponse.title: MonitorConfigResponse

dateCreated.description: When the monitor was created in this environment.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

nextCheckIn.description: Expected timestamp of the next check-in.
nextCheckIn.title: Next Check In

nextCheckInLatest.description: Latest acceptable timestamp for the next check-in before it's considered missed.
nextCheckInLatest.title: Next Check In Latest

MonitorOwner.description: Team or user that owns the monitor.
MonitorOwner.title: MonitorOwner
